message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** or the **City’s Code Enforcement** office rather than the city council itself. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website:
• Navigate to “Police” → “Report a Crime” → “Noise Complaint.”
• Fill out the online form with details (time, location, description, etc.). | Online portal on the city website | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line: **(404) 656‑4000**.
• Tell the dispatcher you’d like to file a noise complaint and provide the necessary details. | (404) 656‑4000 | | **In‑person** | • Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office.
• Submit a written complaint with all relevant information. | Precinct offices or City Hall | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta – Code Enforcement
100 Peachtree Street NW, Suite 200
Atlanta, GA 30303 | 100 Peachtree St. NW, Suite 200 | ### Tips for Filing 1. **Be Specific** – Include exact times, dates, and locations. If possible, note the source of the noise (e.g., construction, party, traffic). 2. **Provide Evidence** – If you have recordings, photos, or witness statements, attach them or bring copies when you submit your complaint. 3. **Follow Up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Use it to check the status of your complaint online or by calling the police department. ### When the City Council Gets Involved The city council may review noise complaints during public meetings or if a pattern of violations emerges, but routine noise issues are generally resolved by the police or code enforcement before reaching the council level. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint in Atlanta—just use the police department or code enforcement channels listed above.
